note: Frontier release radar: expected upcoming models + market-implied odds, adversarially verified against real markets/announcements.

items.basis: Leaked Jul 17 rebuild-target date arrived with NO official GA: Google's blog lists only 3.5 Flash as GA and says Pro is 'rolling out,' no DeepMind model card, no benchmarks or pricing. Leaks claim a 2M context + Deep Think layer. Two weeks left in the July window.
Polymarket ~68% by Dec 31, ~40% by Sep 30, ~2% by Jul 31; OpenAI's roadmap still runs through the GPT-5.6 family (Sol/Terra/Luna public Jul 9), pushing the numbered flagship to late 2026.
Anthropic's ~6-week Opus cadence (4.6 Feb, 4.7 Apr, 4.8 May) points to a next Opus; Polymarket prices a next Claude Opus at ~96% by Oct 31, though the exact version is unannounced.
xAI shipped Grok 4.5 on Jul 8; Manifold prices Grok 5 at ~43% before Sep 2026, with a V9-foundation successor floated but undated.
V4-Pro/Flash shipped Apr 24 as previews; a stable GA is pending, with a reported Jul 24 developer deadline.
